column3: “does not approve” renders seeing as approval.
“hearts and hands” coordinates what the Hebrew connects with “to.”
“eyes” is plural rather than singular; “tears” specifies the water.
“dropped me alive” replaces destroying my life; “stones” is plural rather than singular.
“I thought I was going to die” interprets “I said: I am cut off.”
“Do not ignore” renders hiding the ear; the two expressions for breathing and crying are combined.
